Advance Your Education And Career
We offer the breadth of academic opportunity you expect of a global research university along with the personal attention a smaller institution provides. When you choose the University of Rhode Island to pursue your graduate studies, you join an outstanding and diverse student body and receive research-driven instruction developed in response to the needs and requirements of an ever-changing and expanding global marketplace.
